title: A host can read the pinned evaluation mode and the admitted modes
outcome: A host that spawns evaluators can learn, from machine-readable output alone, which evaluator mode a task pins and which modes the store's policy admits, so it never has to parse operator text or guess.
acceptance: doctor --json carries the active acceptance-evaluation policy and the text report prints it on one line; doctor_reports_the_acceptance_evaluation_policy_in_json_and_text passes
show --json carries the task's pinned evaluation mode and omits the field when nothing is pinned; evaluate_word_records_verdicts_and_the_other_words_disclose_them passes
the installed TermAl still parses the doctor report: the addition is a new key and TermAl's doctor structs do not deny unknown fields

completion.summary: show --json carries a task's pinned evaluation mode (omitted when unpinned) and doctor --json carries the active acceptance-evaluation policy, with one operator text line; committed as 5457c79 after nine green gates, not pushed. The installed TermAl ignores the new doctor key.
